title: Fix 266 prefs
no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-cli-069 already says every command that writes a Chough record refuses while a path under .chough/ is unmerged; pref set and pref unset wrote .chough/preferences.json without the writer lock, so only their lock and a test change.
acceptance_criteria: While a path under .chough/ is unmerged, chough pref set and chough pref unset refuse as refused:unmerged, naming the paths, with .chough/preferences.json and every other file unchanged; chough pref show still runs. With nothing unmerged they write as before, under the writer lock.

answers.constraints: Leif's P2 review comment on #330 and his answer 'Fix first, you resolve' set the scope: pref set and unset take the writer lock, with a regression test that is red first. Deltas none; human gates as plain text in tasks.md. No other lesson or principle constrains it.
